footer.tagline: Car rental in Palu, easy and clearly priced.

home.title: Rent a car in Palu, with a driver or self-drive
home.subtitle: Pick a car, set your schedule, pay online. Pick-up at the airport, the port, or your address in Palu. Clear prices with no hidden fees.
home.perk1Text: You see the full cost before paying. No surprise add-ons.
home.perk2Text: Every driver is approved by our admin and tracked during the trip.
home.perk3Text: Service schedules are logged; cars under service are never rented out.
home.perk4Text: ID and licence photos are stored privately and only seen by admins.
home.fleetSubtitle: From city cars to group minibuses
home.step1Text: Choose the city, date and rental package you need.
home.step2Text: Pay before the deadline so the car is locked in for you.
home.step3Text: Our admin prepares the car and driver. Track the status from Bookings.

faq.q1: What's the difference between with-driver and self-drive?
faq.a1: With driver: the car comes with a driver, 4 or 12 hour packages per day. Self-drive: you drive yourself, rented daily, monthly or yearly.
faq.q2: What documents do I need for self-drive?
faq.a2: A photo of your national ID (KTP) and a valid driving licence (SIM A). Upload them on the Account page and wait for admin approval before booking.
faq.q3: Do prices include fuel and tolls?
faq.a3: The rental price covers the car (and driver for with-driver packages). Fuel, tolls and parking are paid by the renter unless agreed otherwise.
faq.q4: How do I cancel a booking?
faq.a4: Unpaid bookings can be cancelled any time. Paid bookings can be cancelled up to 24 hours before the start; the admin then processes your refund.
faq.q5: How long do I have to pay?
faq.a5: 60 minutes after the booking is created. After that it expires automatically and the car is released.
